name: The Heart of the Mountain

faq.answer: Maxwort Uberglint is a goblin stationed in the scorched wastes of the Burning Steppes who seeks rare treasures.

aliases: what is heart of the mountain
faq.answer: It is a prize of striking beauty that Maxwort Uberglint covets enough to offer payment for its delivery.
faq.q: What is the Heart of the Mountain?

faq.answer: Maxwort Uberglint waits in the Burning Steppes, north of the Redridge Mountains.

sections.body: Maxwort Uberglint has set his sights on a prize he considers magnificent beyond reckoning. He waits in the ash of the Burning Steppes for someone daring enough to carry the stone into his hands, promising good coin in return.
sections.title: A Goblin's Desire

sections.body: Maxwort Uberglint marvels at the stone, finding it even more wondrous than he envisioned, and pays handsomely for your trouble.
sections.title: A Prized Delivery

summary: Maxwort Uberglint seeks the Heart of the Mountain from the fiery depths of Blackrock. Delivering the rare gem to him in the Burning Steppes earns a goblin's grateful payment.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Heart of the Mountain
